_instructions: Section 9 parameter block of the V1.1 task sheet plus the phase 2 (V2.1) additions.
Every null entry must be filled by the user; nothing here is a device value.
to list the entries that are still missing for the selected prior_model.
This template selects prior_model = ZOH, the phase 1 path.  For the six state
FOH path use parameter-template-foh.json, which drops q_a and q_a_grid.

_units.k_cv: digital per m (displacement to analog to digital chain included)
_units.K_p: control unit per digital error, discrete
_units.K_i: control unit per digital error, discrete, already contains any Ts factor
_units.K_d: control unit per digital error, discrete, already contains any Ts factor
_units.sigma_n2: (digital error)^2, discrete variance, never rescaled by fs
_units.mechanical_noise_psd: N^2/Hz when mechanical_noise_unit is force, (m/s^2)^2/Hz when it is accel
_units.q_j: (m/s^3)^2 per sample, FOH path only; it is not q_a and a numerically equal value has no meaning
_units.jerk0_hat: m/s^3, prior mean of the Jerk state
_units.P0_FOH: 6x6 covariance of [x, v, a, j, I, e[-1]], or leave null and give P0 plus jerk_var0
_units.jerk_var0: (m/s^3)^2, Jerk variance used when P0_FOH is assembled from the five state P0
_units.jerk_init_mode: known (zero Jerk variance and zero cross covariances) or unknown (finite positive variance)
_units.X0_hat: five entries [x, v, a, I, e[-1]]; six entries are accepted on the FOH path
_units.P0: 5x5 covariance of the five common states
_units.state_scales: one positive scale per state, six entries on the FOH path; the Jerk scale must be set separately
